The integration is managed by a wiki admin.
Nastavení YouTrack se mezitím změnilo. Z: The YouTrack settings have changed in the meantime. Try the request again.
Adresa YouTrack musí být HTTPS bez přihl: The YouTrack address must be HTTPS without credentials, parameters or a fragment.
The token cannot be changed and removed at the same time.
Každý prostor může mít právě jednu sadu: Each space can have exactly one set of allowed projects.
Použijte stabilní ID projektů YouTrack,: Use stable YouTrack project IDs, for example 0-7; at most 100 per space.
Pro zapnutí integrace vyplňte adresu a n: To turn on the integration, fill in the address and a new access token.
Úkol nebyl nalezen v povolených projekte: The issue was not found in the allowed projects.
You can verify 1 to 100 issues at once.
YouTrack není dostupný. Zkontrolujte ulo: YouTrack is not available. Check the saved connection, the service account's permissions and the allowed projects, or try the request later.
Použijte výraz do 256 znaků, ID úkolu ne: Use an expression of up to 256 characters, an issue ID or a link from the configured YouTrack.
Spojení funguje. Vyberte projekty povole: The connection works. Choose the projects allowed for individual spaces.
